faq.q: How does the free trial work?
faq.a: Sign up and create your first event: that starts a {trialDays}-day free trial, with no card needed. Everything works, including video, the live wall and share links. The one thing that needs a plan is downloading originals and ZIPs.

Both include everything and cover unlimited events. Monthly is {monthly} a month. Yearly is {yearly}, which saves {saving}% compared with paying monthly for a year. You can switch at any time from Manage billing.
Yes. Cancel from Manage billing in your dashboard. It takes effect at the end of the period you've already paid for, and everything keeps working until then.

faq.q: What happens to my photos if I cancel?
faq.a: When your paid period ends, your events stop taking new uploads. You can still view and download everything for {readOnlyDays} days, then the files are deleted. We email you before that happens. Subscribe again within those {readOnlyDays} days and everything comes straight back.

faq.q: What if I don't subscribe after the trial?
faq.a: Your events become read-only and downloads stay locked. We keep the files for {trialKeepDays} days after the trial ends, and email you a week before they're deleted. Subscribe at any point in those {trialKeepDays} days and everything unlocks immediately.
Yes. Your first payment comes with a {days}-day money-back guarantee. Email {email} within {days} days of it and we'll refund you in full, no questions asked.
Never. Guests scan and upload for free, with no app and no account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: {brand} (also available as {alias} at {aliasDomain}) lets hosts collect photos, videos and messages from their guests. This page explains what personal data we handle and why. We are based in London, UK.

p: {brand} is operated from London, UK. The data controller is [COMPANY NAME] (TODO), company number [COMPANY NUMBER] (TODO), registered address [REGISTERED ADDRESS] (TODO), ICO registration number [ICO REGISTRATION NUMBER] (TODO).
Questions or requests: {email}.

list: Hosts: your email address, name, the details of the events you create, and your subscription and payment records (plan, status, renewal dates). Card details are handled by Stripe and never reach us.
Guests: the first name you type, and the photos, videos, voice messages and reactions you upload.
Enquiries: what you tell us when you contact us.
Technical data: IP address, device type and basic usage logs, used to keep the service secure and running.

sections.h: Why we use your data and our lawful bases
p: Under Article 6 of the UK GDPR we rely on the following lawful bases:
list: Contract (Article 6(1)(b)): to create and run events, store and show uploads to the people the host has chosen, send sign-in codes and receipts, and take payment.

Legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)): to keep the service secure, prevent abuse, fix problems and improve the service. For guests, this includes running the album you chose to take part in. We balance these interests against your rights.
Legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c)): to keep accounting and tax records and respond to lawful requests.
Consent (Article 6(1)(a)): only where we ask for it separately, and you can withdraw it at any time.

p: To help hosts review uploads, images may be sent to OpenAI's moderation service, which flags content that may be inappropriate, blurry or duplicated. It is used only for this purpose. No decision with a legal or similarly significant effect is made solely by automated means: the host decides what to keep, show or remove.

We use only essential cookies: a sign-in session for hosts, a language preference, and a per-event token that lets a guest's device keep its uploads together. We store only a hashed version of that token. These are strictly necessary to provide the service you ask for, so they are exempt from the consent requirement under PECR (the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations). We do not use advertising, analytics or tracking cookies.
These providers process data on our behalf, only to run the service:
list: Vercel: hosting
Neon: database (London)
Vercel Blob: photo, video and audio storage (London)
Resend: email delivery
Stripe: payments
OpenAI: automated image moderation

p: Our database and media storage are in London. Some providers, for example for payments, email delivery or image moderation, may process limited data outside the UK. When that happens we only use providers covered by UK adequacy regulations, or we put safeguards in place such as the UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) or the UK Addendum to the EU standard contractual clauses.

list: Event photos, videos and messages: while the host's subscription is active. If the host's free trial ends without a subscription, they are kept for {trialKeepDays} days and then deleted. If a subscription ends, they stay viewable and downloadable for {readOnlyDays} days after the paid period ends and are then deleted. Hosts can delete an event or individual uploads at any time.
Account details: while your account is open, then deleted when you delete your account (which also cancels any subscription) or on request.

Payment, subscription and invoice records: kept by us and by Stripe for six years, as UK tax and accounting rules require. Stripe also keeps its own records as an independent controller under its privacy policy.
Enquiries: for as long as needed to deal with them.

p: Hosts are responsible for telling their guests that photos and videos will be collected and shared. If you appear in a photo and want it removed, ask the host first or email us.

Our service is not aimed at children. Photos of children may be uploaded by hosts and guests at family events; hosts and parents are responsible for sharing them appropriately, and we will remove content on request.
Under UK GDPR you have the right to:
list: access the personal data we hold about you
have inaccurate data corrected (rectification)
have your data deleted (erasure)
restrict how we use it
receive your data in a portable format
object to processing based on legitimate interests

sections.h: How to use your rights and complain
p: Email {email}. We will reply within one month, free of charge. We may need to confirm your identity, and for complex requests we may extend the time by up to two further months and will tell you why.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113. We would appreciate the chance to put things right first.
We may update this policy and will show the date above.
Email {email}.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use {brand} (also available as {alias} at {aliasDomain}) as a host or as a guest. By using the service you agree to them.

p: {brand} lets a host create an event page and QR code so guests can upload and view photos, videos and messages. Hosts use it on a free trial or on a paid subscription. Every feature is included on both, except that downloading originals needs a paid subscription.

list: You are responsible for the events you create and for who you share the link with.
You must have the right to collect the content and should let guests know it will be shared.
You are responsible for removing content that should not be there.

p: You may only upload content you have the right to share. Do not upload anything that is unlawful, abusive or infringes someone else's rights. You keep ownership of what you upload and give the host and us permission to store and display it as part of the event.
Do not misuse, attack or scrape the service, or upload malware. We may remove content or suspend events that break these terms.

list: There is one subscription, billed monthly ({monthly} a month) or yearly ({yearly} a year), in pounds sterling with VAT included, and processed by Stripe. It covers unlimited events for the account, subject to fair use.
Your subscription renews automatically at the end of each month or year, and the card you used is charged until you cancel. We will remind you before a yearly renewal.

You can cancel at any time from Manage billing in your dashboard. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you have already paid for; you keep full access until then and you will not be charged again.
You can switch between monthly and yearly from Manage billing. The change is handled by Stripe, which may credit any unused time.
If we change the price, we will email you at least 30 days before the change applies to your next renewal, and you can cancel before then.

If a renewal payment fails, everything keeps working for {graceDays} days while you update your card. After that the subscription ends and your events become read-only, as described under "Storage and deletion".

Money-back guarantee: you can ask for a full refund of your first subscription payment within {days} days of it, no questions asked. Email {email} from the address on your account. Refunds are made by our support team, back to the original payment method through Stripe, and the subscription is cancelled when the refund is made. The guarantee applies once per customer and does not cover later renewals.

Your statutory cancellation right: under the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 you normally have 14 days from the start of a contract for a digital service to cancel it. By subscribing you ask us to start the service straight away. If you cancel within those 14 days you may be asked to pay for the service already provided, in proportion; our money-back guarantee above gives you a full refund of your first payment in any case.
Renewals are not refundable, but you can cancel at any time so that you are not charged again.
The free trial lasts {trialDays} days and starts when you create your first event. No card is needed and nothing is charged automatically when it ends.

During the trial everything works except downloads: you and your guests can view everything, including the live wall and share links, but originals and ZIP files can only be downloaded on a paid subscription.
There is one free trial per person. We may end trials that are used to get around this.
While your subscription is active, we keep your events' photos, videos and messages.
If your trial ends without a subscription, your events become read-only (no new uploads) and downloads stay locked. We keep the files for {trialKeepDays} days after the trial ends, then delete them.
If your subscription ends, your events become read-only, and you can still view and download everything for {readOnlyDays} days after the paid period ends. Then the files are deleted.
We email you before files are deleted. Subscribing again before the deletion date restores everything straight away.
We cannot guarantee uninterrupted service, so keep your own copies of anything important.

p: Unlimited means unlimited for normal personal use: your own weddings, parties and family occasions. We may contact you, and if needed limit or suspend an account, if its use is far beyond that (for example running events commercially for other people, or storage or traffic that affects the service for others). We will always tell you first and give you a chance to download your content.

We provide the service with reasonable care but on an as-is basis. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including for death or personal injury caused by negligence or for fraud.
If you are a consumer, nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, including that digital services must be provided with reasonable care and skill.
We may update these terms and will show the date above. If a change is significant, we will tell hosts with a subscription or an active trial by email before it applies.

These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have jurisdiction, although if you live elsewhere in the UK you may also bring proceedings in your local courts.
Email {email}.
